text: はねをもたないが　たまに　そらを　とぶ　すがたが　もくげきされる。

structure.jp: そらを　とぶ　すがたが
structure.en: the sight of it flying through the sky

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: される is する turned around, so the thing is done to it by others. もくげきされる = 'is witnessed'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: そらを　とぶ　すがた
patterns.explanation: The phrase before すがた tells you what the figure is doing. そらを　とぶ　すがた = 'the sight of it flying through the sky'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a statement means 'but'. はねをもたないが = 'it has no wings, but'.
